comparison.objective: Candidate finishes four inserts by tang removal; record tightens a child-seat anchor strap while pressing the seat into a cushion.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires mandrel alignment, hammering, withdrawal, and fragment pickup; record requires coordinated seat compression and strap take-up/tensioning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, retained inserts, and total tang containment; record requires a firmly fitted seat followed by release, but available evidence omits quantitative tightness thresholds.
comparison.reason: Compliant-seat loading and strap tensioning are materially different from controlled notch fracture.
